page_texts.1: Read `.claude/commands/command.md` for the full workflow. Determines the Workflow name from the request, checks `.claude/commands/<name>.md` for an existing match, and either authors a new Command + Prompt pair (opening statement, `$ARGUMENTS` scope routing, numbered steps with concrete tool invocations and canonical-path Skill references) or revises the existing pair in place. Ends with a convergence pass per `.claude/skills/ai-convergence/SKILL.md`.
